# JSONPathEx v0.3.0 - Table of Contents

A fast Elixir library for parsing and evaluating JSONPath expressions, with RFC 9535-aligned filter semantics.

## Pages

- [JSONPathEx](https://jsonpath-ex.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://jsonpath-ex.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://jsonpath-ex.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [JSONPathEx](https://jsonpath-ex.hexdocs.pm/JSONPathEx.md): Main interface for the JSONPathEx library.
- [JSONPathEx.Evaluator](https://jsonpath-ex.hexdocs.pm/JSONPathEx.Evaluator.md): Evaluates JSONPath Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) against JSON data.
- [JSONPathEx.Parser](https://jsonpath-ex.hexdocs.pm/JSONPathEx.Parser.md): Defines parsers for JSONPath expressions using NimbleParsec.
